title: Life plan
description: Machine view of the Life & Career Plan (session 1): purpose, post-degree route, money, eligibility facts, geography and language, timeline, household. Human view: 01_life_plan/life_plan.md. Private file; published outputs use profile_summary only.

applicant_alias.description: Alias used in all outputs (never the real name).

profile_summary.description: One public-safe line used in reports, e.g. 'Applicant B, career changer, five years in marketing'. No names, employers, places or dates of birth.

purpose_horizon.description: LP-G1: why a postgraduate degree, over what horizon (rubric: purpose and horizon_years present).

purpose.description: What the degree is for, stated as work or outcomes rather than a title.

horizon_years.description: Years until the goal (the 3-5 year picture).

declared_unknown.description: true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).

post_degree_intent.description: LP-G2: the route after the degree (rubric: intent present; if several routes are open, keep_open_is says whether keeping them open is a requirement or a hedge).

intent.description: Main intended route after the degree.

routes_open.description: Every route the person wants to keep open, using the same vocabulary as intent.

keep_open_is.description: If several routes are open: is keeping them all open a requirement of the programme, or only a hedge? not_applicable when only one route is open.

detail.description: Detail, e.g. target organisations or sectors.

declared_unknown.description: true = the person consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).

money.description: LP-G3: money turned into testable numbers (rubric: funded_type + at least one number + currency + debt_acceptable stated).

funded_type.description: stipend_and_tuition = tuition-free AND a living stipend; tuition_only = tuition covered, living costs paid by the applicant; affordable = the applicant pays, below a ceiling.

max_total_tuition.description: Ceiling for TOTAL tuition over the whole degree, in `currency` (null = no ceiling stated).

max_out_of_pocket.description: Ceiling for everything the applicant can pay themselves over the whole degree (tuition + one-off costs + the part of living costs not covered), in `currency`.

living_support_required_monthly.description: Monthly living support the programme/funding must provide for the whole household (see household_size), in `currency`.

household_size.description: People the living support must cover (applicant + dependants). 1 = applicant alone.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of all amounts in this section.

debt_acceptable.description: May the applicant take on debt (student loan) to study? null = not asked yet.

debt_limit.description: Maximum debt in `currency` if debt_acceptable is true.

income_during_degree.description: Monthly income the applicant keeps during the degree (job, remote work, savings drawdown), in `currency`; null = unknown, 0 = none.

dependants_on_income.description: Number of people who depend on the applicant's income today.

hardness.description: hard = reject below; soft = prefer; keep_and_flag = keep record, flag the failure.

declared_unknown.description: true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).

eligibility_facts.description: LP-G4: facts that decide scholarship and admission eligibility (rubric: citizenships, residence country and region, highest degree with field, graduation year, grade and scale, and language-certificate status). Use categories, not identifiers.

citizenships.description: Citizenship(s) as country names or ISO codes. Many schemes depend on them; dual citizens list both.

residence_country.description: Country of residence now (scheme residency rules, fee status).

residence_region.description: Region/state inside the country of residence. Write '' if no rule depends on it; the key must be present.

graduation_year.description: Year of graduation (many schemes cap years since graduation; a year never goes stale, an age does).

grade_scale.description: Scale of the grade, e.g. '0-100', '4.0 GPA', 'first-class honours'.

language_certificates.description: Language certificates held or planned (with dates). May be empty ONLY if language_certificates_note says 'none'.

test.description: Test name, e.g. IELTS Academic, TOEFL iBT, DELF B2.

expires.description: Expiry date (many are valid 2 years); null if it does not expire.

language_certificates_note.description: Status of certificates: 'none' if the applicant holds none, or e.g. 'IELTS booked for 2027-03'.

fee_status.description: Fee status the universities are expected to assign, in the vocabulary of the target regions (e.g. 'international', 'home', 'overseas'). Free text and optional: it is not a gate.

languages.description: Languages the person speaks, with level (CEFR or plain words).

declared_unknown.description: true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).

geography.description: LP-G5: where and in which language (rubric: considered countries non-empty).

considered.description: Countries in scope. If the applicant names a region, list its countries here after a keep/drop per country.

excluded.description: Countries out of scope with the reason (so the reason survives into the search plan).

languages_willing_c1.description: Languages the applicant is willing to learn to C1 before or during the degree.

teaching_languages_accepted.description: Languages of instruction the applicant accepts today.

declared_unknown.description: true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).

timeline.description: LP-G6: when the person can start (rubric: earliest_start, latest_start, immovable_dates list (may be empty), wait_one_cycle true/false).

immovable_dates.description: Dates that cannot move (visa expiry, contract end, family events), each as 'YYYY-MM-DD: what'. Empty list = none.

wait_one_cycle.description: Would the applicant wait a whole application cycle for a clearly better option? null = not asked.

declared_unknown.description: true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).

household.description: LP-G7: household and obligations (rubric: dependants number, partner_moves true/false, return_obligation_stance, deal_breakers list (an explicit empty list = none)). If a partner moves, partner_work_needed says whether they need work rights.

dependants.description: Number of dependants who would travel with, or stay behind because of, the degree.

partner_moves.description: Would a partner move too? Write false when there is no partner. null = not asked yet (gate LP-G7 requires true or false).

partner_work_needed.description: Must the partner be allowed to work abroad? null = not applicable.

return_obligation_stance.description: Attitude to schemes that require returning home or working for a sponsor after the degree.

deal_breakers.description: Conditions that rule an option out, one per entry.

declared_unknown.description: true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).
true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).
true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).

description.description: A concrete target role or sector.

declared_unknown.description: true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).

ranked.description: Criteria in order of importance, most important first.

declared_unknown.description: true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).

risk_tolerance.description: LP-S5: appetite for financial risk and for long-shot options (low, medium or high for each).

money.description: Risk tolerance on money (a funding route that may fall through).

long_shots.description: Appetite for long-shot options (a programme whose pathway or funding is not yet confirmed).

declared_unknown.description: true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).
true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).

items.description: How the final choice will be made.

declared_unknown.description: true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).

support_assets.description: LP-S8: application assets (referees, portfolio, publications, existing contacts).

items.description: Referees, portfolio, publications, contacts, savings or family support.

declared_unknown.description: true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).
true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).

notes.description: City size, weather, distance from home, community; or 'no preference'.

declared_unknown.description: true = the applicant consciously leaves this open (counts as declared_unknown in the rubric).
